name: Mighty Wasp 74
author: NlghtM4re
description: Outlined rounded cyan radio button that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #a4d7f6 to #89cffb. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #a4d7f6 to #47afef, box-shadow becomes #0b466b 0px 5px 29px 5px.
